contact_edits.before: Among his other impersonations, I especially enjoyed his air ministry recruiting wallah, who has the voice, the praying-mantis eyes and the gleefully rubbing hands of an English Montgomery Burns. Gray also does his share of expert mimicry, both as singer and composer; there's one song in which he sounds, whether by accident or design, like a dead vocal ringer for Randy Newman. Camellia Koo has designed a simple objet-trouve kind of set; projections are held in reserve until the last moment and are the more effective for it. Peterson himself remains a sharp-eyed scamp underneath it all, a jewel in a cock-eyed Canadian crown. He adds, in himself, a layer to the evening, something and someone to cheer for. - Billy Bishop Goes to War runs until Aug. 29. Call 416-866-8666 or visit soulpepper.cafor tickets and information.
